title: Split phone_backup.sh's capture half into a tested library
objective: Take phone_backup.sh from 333 lines to under the repo's 250-line cap by moving its five capture functions into lib/backup_capture.sh, and give that library 100% line coverage — the code that decides what a phone backup actually contains had no test at all.
acceptance_criteria: bash meta/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all no longer lists phone_focus_mode/phone_backup.sh, and no new file is over the cap.
bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage.sh phone_focus_mode/lib/tests/test_backup_capture.sh backup_capture.sh exits 0 at its default 100% minimum.
Every assertion is mutation-proofed, with zero survivors, including a mutation that reintroduces the stdin-draining bug pull_apks' comment documents.
meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh reports every function moved verbatim, except any function deliberately rewritten — for which the rendered output must be proven byte-identical instead.
shellcheck passes on each touched file individually, with no -x and no disable directive.
SDCARD_DIRS is assigned in the same file that reads it, so neither file assigns a global it never reads (SC2034).
phone_backup.sh --help exits 0 and --verify against an empty directory behaves exactly as it does at HEAD.
out_of_scope: Editing deploy.sh's two hardcoded lists: phone_backup.sh is PC-side and appears in neither, so this split needs no list edits.
Splitting verify_backup, write_manifest, print_manual_checklist or main out of the entry script, which is already under the cap without them.
Any device deploy or verification against a real phone; there is none in this session.
verifier: bash phone_focus_mode/lib/tests/test_backup_capture.sh (expects 22 passed, 0 failed), plus bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage.sh phone_focus_mode/lib/tests/test_backup_capture.sh backup_capture.sh at 100.00%, plus the mutation run at 13 killed / 0 survived, plus bash meta/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all showing 21 files, plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files.
